interface CacheEntry<V> {
  value: V;
  expiresAt: number;
}

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

function isExpired(entry: CacheEntry<unknown>, now: number): boolean {
  return now >= entry.expiresAt;
}

function purgeExpired<K, V>(store: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>, now: number): void {
  for (const [key, entry] of store) {
    if (isExpired(entry, now)) {
      store.delete(key);
    }
  }
}

function evictOldest<K, V>(store: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>): void {
  const oldestKey = store.keys().next().value;
  if (oldestKey !== undefined) {
    store.delete(oldestKey);
  }
}

function refreshRecency<K, V>(store: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>, key: K): void {
  const entry = store.get(key);
  if (entry !== undefined) {
    store.delete(key);
    store.set(key, entry);
  }
}

export function createLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> {
  const store = new Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>();

  return {
    get(key: K): V | undefined {
      const now = clock.now();
      const entry = store.get(key);
      if (entry === undefined || isExpired(entry, now)) {
        store.delete(key);
        return undefined;
      }
      refreshRecency(store, key);
      return entry.value;
    },

      const now = clock.now();
      if (store.has(key)) {
        refreshRecency(store, key);
        store.set(key, { value, expiresAt: now + ttlMs });
        return;

      if (store.size >= capacity) {
        evictOldest(store);
      }
      store.set(key, { value, expiresAt: now + ttlMs });
    },

    has(key: K): boolean {
      const now = clock.now();
      const entry = store.get(key);
      if (entry === undefined || isExpired(entry, now)) {
        store.delete(key);
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    },

    get size(): number {
      const now = clock.now();
      let count = 0;
      for (const entry of store.values()) {
        if (!isExpired(entry, now)) {

export type Result =
  | { readonly ok: true; readonly value: number }
  | { readonly ok: false; readonly error: string };

const err = (msg: string): Result => ({ ok: false, error: msg });
const ok = (val: number): Result => ({ ok: true, value: val });

interface Parser {
  readonly src: string;
  pos: number;
}

function skipWs(p: Parser): void {
  while (p.pos < p.src.length && /\s/.test(p.src[p.pos])) {
    p.pos++;
  }
}

function peek(p: Parser): string | undefined {
  return p.pos < p.src.length ? p.src[p.pos] : undefined;
}

function parseNum(p: Parser): Result {
  if (p.pos >= p.src.length || !/\d/.test(p.src[p.pos])) {
    return err('Missing operand');
  }
  let n = '';
  while (p.pos < p.src.length && /\d/.test(p.src[p.pos])) {
    n += p.src[p.pos++];
  }
  return ok(Number(n));
}

function parseFact(p: Parser): Result {
  skipWs(p);
  const ch = peek(p);
  if (ch === '(') {
    p.pos++;
    const r = parseExpr(p);
    if (!r.ok) return r;
    skipWs(p);
    if (peek(p) !== ')') return err('Unbalanced parentheses');
    p.pos++;
    return r;
  }
  if (ch === '-' || ch === '+') {
    p.pos++;
    const r = parseFact(p);
    return r.ok ? ok(ch === '-' ? -r.value : r.value) : r;
  }
  return parseNum(p);
}

function parseTerm(p: Parser): Result {
  let r = parseFact(p);
  if (!r.ok) return r;
  while (true) {
    skipWs(p);
    const op = peek(p);
    if (op !== '*' && op !== '/') break;
    p.pos++;
    const rhs = parseFact(p);
    if (!rhs.ok) return rhs;
    if (op === '/' && rhs.value === 0) return err('Division by zero');
    r = ok(op === '/' ? r.value / rhs.value : r.value * rhs.value);
  }
  return r;
}

function parseExpr(p: Parser): Result {
  let r = parseTerm(p);
  if (!r.ok) return r;
  while (true) {
    skipWs(p);
    const op = peek(p);
    if (op !== '+' && op !== '-') break;
    p.pos++;
    const rhs = parseTerm(p);
    if (!rhs.ok) return rhs;
    r = ok(op === '-' ? r.value - rhs.value : r.value + rhs.value);
  }
  return r;
}

export function evaluate(expr: string): Result {
  try {
    const p: Parser = { src: expr, pos: 0 };
    const res = parseExpr(p);
    if (!res.ok) return res;
    skipWs(p);
    if (p.pos < p.src.length) return err('Unexpected character');
    return res;
  } catch (e: unknown) {
    return err(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Evaluation failed');
  }
}

export interface Entry {
  readonly key: string;
  readonly amount: number;
}

export interface Store {
  add(entry: Entry): void;
  total(key: string): number;
  all(): readonly Entry[];
  remove(key: string): void;
}

class StoreImpl implements Store {
  private readonly entries: Entry[] = [];
  private readonly totals = new Map<string, number>();

  add(entry: Entry): void {
    this.entries.push(entry);
    this.totals.set(entry.key, (this.totals.get(entry.key) ?? 0) + entry.amount);
  }

  total(key: string): number {
    return this.totals.get(key) ?? 0;
  }

  all(): readonly Entry[] {
    return this.entries;
  }

  remove(key: string): void {
    let i = 0;
    while (i < this.entries.length) {
      if (this.entries[i].key === key) {
        this.entries.splice(i, 1);
      } else {
        i++;
      }
    }
    this.totals.set(key, 0);
  }
}

export function createStore(): Store {
  return new StoreImpl();
}

import type { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';

interface CacheEntry<K, V> {
  readonly key: K;
  value: V;
  readonly insertedAt: number;
}

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

function isExpired(entry: CacheEntry<K, V>, now: number, ttlMs: number): boolean {
  return now >= entry.insertedAt + ttlMs;
}

export function createLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> {
  const entries: CacheEntry<K, V>[] = [];

  const getLiveSize = (): number =>
    entries.filter(entry => !isExpired(entry, clock.now(), ttlMs)).length;

  const evictLruLive = (): void => {
    while (entries.length > 0) {
      const entry = entries.shift();
      if (entry === undefined) break;
      if (!isExpired(entry, clock.now(), ttlMs)) {
        break;
      }
    }
  };

  return {
    get(key: K): V | undefined {
      const idx = entries.findIndex(entry => entry.key === key);
      if (idx === -1) return undefined;

      const entry = entries[idx];
      if (isExpired(entry, clock.now(), ttlMs)) {
        entries.splice(idx, 1);
        return undefined;
      }

      entries.splice(idx, 1);
      entries.push(entry);
      return entry.value;
    },

    set(key: K, value: V): void {
      const idx = entries.findIndex(entry => entry.key === key);
      if (idx !== -1) {
        const entry = entries[idx];
        if (isExpired(entry, clock.now(), ttlMs)) {
          entries.splice(idx, 1);
        } else {
          entry.value = value;
          entries.splice(idx, 1);
          entries.push({ ...entry, insertedAt: clock.now() });
          return;
        }
      }

      entries.push({ key, value, insertedAt: clock.now() });

      while (getLiveSize() > capacity) {
        evictLruLive();
      }
    },

    has(key: K): boolean {
      const idx = entries.findIndex(entry => entry.key === key);
      if (idx === -1) return false;

      const entry = entries[idx];
      if (isExpired(entry, clock.now(), ttlMs)) {
        entries.splice(idx, 1);
        return false;
      }

      return true;
    },

    get size(): number {
      return getLiveSize();
    },
  };
}

  clock: Clock

  if (firstKey === undefined) return;

  }

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;

export function createLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> {
  const state: CacheState<K, V> = {
    map: new Map(),
    capacity,
    ttlMs,
    clock,
    liveSize: 0,
  };

  return {
    get(key: K): V | undefined {
      const entry = state.map.get(key);
      if (entry === undefined) return undefined;

      if (isExpired(entry, state.clock)) {
        state.map.delete(key);
        state.liveSize -= 1;
        return undefined;
      }

      state.map.delete(key);
      state.map.set(key, entry);
      return entry.value;
    },

    set(key: K, value: V): void {
      const existing = state.map.get(key);
      const now = state.clock.now();

      if (existing !== undefined) {
        if (isExpired(existing, state.clock)) {
          state.liveSize -= 1;
        }
      } else {
        state.liveSize += 1;
      }

      }

      if (entry === undefined) return false;

      if (isExpired(entry, state.clock)) {
        state.map.delete(key);
        state.liveSize -= 1;
        return false;
      }

      return true;
    },

      return state.liveSize;

const DEFAULT_TOKENS = 1;

interface BucketState {
  tokens: number;
  lastRefillAt: number;
}

export interface RateLimiter {
  tryAcquire(key: string, tokens?: number): boolean;
}

const refillBucket = (
  bucket: BucketState,
  capacity: number,
  refillPerSec: number,
  now: number
): void => {
  const elapsedMs = now - bucket.lastRefillAt;
  const newTokens = Math.floor((elapsedMs / 1000) * refillPerSec);
  bucket.tokens = Math.min(capacity, bucket.tokens + newTokens);
  bucket.lastRefillAt = now;
};

export const createRateLimiter = (
  capacity: number,
  refillPerSec: number,
  clock: Clock
): RateLimiter => {
  const buckets = new Map<string, BucketState>();

  const tryAcquire = (key: string, tokens: number = DEFAULT_TOKENS): boolean => {
    const now = clock.now();
    let bucket = buckets.get(key);

    if (bucket === undefined) {
      bucket = { tokens: capacity, lastRefillAt: now };
      buckets.set(key, bucket);
    }

    refillBucket(bucket, capacity, refillPerSec, now);

    if (bucket.tokens < tokens) {
      return false;
    }

    bucket.tokens -= tokens;
    return true;
  };

  return { tryAcquire };
};
